lines.text: Time to build an app that a real person could use, with everything from this course: lists, procedures, validation and data.
Ideas: a revision quiz app with several topics, a habit tracker with statistics, a sports score keeper, a dice-game simulator with results.
Lists for the data, at least one procedure, input validation, and a clear output (statistics, score or result).
Give your app to two people with no instructions.
Watch where they get confused, and fix it.
Demo the app, show one procedure and explain the data structure.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
